reading: A best-of-family run this large is uncommon under no skill, but the signal gates — not the run — still decide promotion.
payout_assumption: flat 1 unit won / 1 unit lost, graded against the project reference line (not a market price)
note: Simulated by resampling each strategy's own bet count as coin flips; the strategies share games, so the true spread of lucky runs is somewhat wider than this independence assumption implies (recorded, not hidden).
